description: Premier beach haven offering golden shores, Portuguese architecture, water sports, and seafood curries.

name: Manali
description: Snow-capped Himalayan peaks, pine-covered mountain trails, paragliding, and cozy alpine cafes.

name: Kerala
description: Misty rolling tea estates, blissful luxury houseboat stays, and coconut-infused Malabar gastronomy.

description: High-altitude desert surrounded by towering Himalayan ranges, azure lakes, and ancient cliffside gompas.

description: Idyllic tropical haven blending rice terraces, Hindu water temples, sea-cliff sunsets, and surf breaks.

description: Romantic heart of Europe celebrated for iconic monuments, Louvre art masterpieces, and chic sidewalk cafes.

name: Rishikesh

name: Varanasi

name: Queenstown
